protocol.views: identical per-patch seeded training-style scale/offset/noise views for every metric
protocol.inference: VoxTell-native padding, sliding windows and Gaussian-weighted logit fusion before sigmoid
protocol.oracle: patchwise candidate-view GT Dice; fixed-view Dice is reported separately and never used for patch gap

protocol.similarity: voxelwise cosine between frozen project_bottleneck_embed output and native project_text_embed output
protocol.correlation: full-volume finite-pair Spearman(similarity, final foreground probability); constant maps are invalid
protocol.view_selection: per-case argmax score over valid views; CAC uses finite scores, TRA uses finite defined correlations
protocol.gt_usage: GT from train/test splits is accessed only in this offline audit for Dice/recall/precision evaluation and correlations; neither prompt maps, predictions nor selection use GT
protocol.view_generation: the case seed generates all training-style scale/offset/noise views once over the full padded volume; every sliding-window patch crops those same aligned views
